title: Settings drawer
description: Global Studio settings for the workspace, interaction, and profile-related preferences.

ui.overview: The Settings drawer gathers the options that change how Studio behaves across the whole session. Use it when you need to adjust the interface instead of the current journey.

controls.label: Global Settings
controls.description: Opens the app-wide settings for workspace behavior, editing defaults, and shared preferences.

controls.label: User Interface
controls.description: Opens the visual and interaction preferences for the Studio surface.

controls.label: Manage My Profile
controls.description: Opens profile-specific options for the current browser or account state.

controls.label: Units System
controls.description: Chooses Metric or Imperial units and DD or DMS coordinate format.

controls.label: Camera Settings
controls.description: Controls camera information, target markers, initial focus, and orbit behavior.

controls.label: Journey Statistics Settings
controls.description: Selects an activity profile and tunes duration, distance, altitude, speed, and climb thresholds. Each threshold can be reset.

controls.label: Menu / Compass / Editor / PWA Settings
controls.description: Groups the preferences for the menu, compass, editor, and installable application behavior.

controls.label: Sync my profile
controls.description: Lets you enter a token and save or clear profile synchronization.

controls.label: Reset profile
controls.description: Selects data to reset, such as journeys, POIs, widgets, settings, or tokens, then applies Reset.

steps.title: Choose a category
steps.description: Open Global Settings, User Interface, or Manage My Profile according to the scope of the change.

steps.title: Set units
steps.description: In Units System, choose Metric or Imperial and the DD or DMS coordinate format.

steps.title: Configure camera and statistics
steps.description: Adjust the switches and selectors in Camera Settings, then tune the activity profile thresholds in Journey Statistics Settings.

steps.title: Sync or reset
steps.description: In the profile area, save a token with Save or select exactly which data to clear before choosing Reset.

notes: Changes here affect the Studio as a whole, not a single drawer or widget.
Use this drawer for repeated configuration, not for one-time decisions.
